name: Do I need a building permit to remodel a bathroom in the Denver metro area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a building permit to remodel a bathroom in the Denver metro area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Permits are generally required for full bathroom remodels whenever you move plumbing lines, alter electrical circuits, or remove framing walls. Cosmetic tasks like repainting or swapping a faucet in the same location do not require permits, but adding a walk-in shower, moving a toilet, or rewiring outlets to GFCI standards does. In Colorado communities such as Denver, Centennial, and Parker, local building departments require inspections during rough-in stages before walls are closed with drywall or cement backer board. Working with a licensed contractor ensures structural, plumbing, and electrical codes are met and inspected properly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, full remodels that involve moving plumbing, changing electrical wiring, or altering framing require permits and municipal inspections.
